justification: Implementing GHG reduction targets can reinforce food quality by reducing pollution and promoting sustainable agriculture practices, which in turn can improve food safety and quality.
Reducing GHG emissions can create conditions that further food affordability by promoting sustainable agriculture practices and reducing production costs.
Achieving GHG reduction targets is indivisibly linked to reducing pesticide use, as sustainable agriculture practices are essential for both climate change mitigation and pesticide reduction.
Promoting competitive agriculture can reinforce food quality by supporting sustainable agriculture practices, improving food safety, and reducing the environmental impact of agriculture.
Improving agricultural competitiveness can create conditions that further food affordability by increasing efficiency and reducing production costs.
Protecting workers' rights and promoting fair labour conditions can reinforce food quality by ensuring that food production and processing are done in a safe and healthy environment.
Promoting social security and workers' protection can create conditions that further food affordability by reducing poverty and improving access to nutritious food.
Reducing pesticide use is indivisibly linked to improving food quality, as it reduces the risk of pesticide residues in food and promotes sustainable agriculture practices.
Reducing pesticide use can create conditions that further food affordability by reducing production costs and promoting sustainable agriculture practices.
Improving food quality can reinforce efforts to improve air quality, as sustainable agriculture practices can reduce air pollution and promote a healthier environment.
Promoting food quality can reinforce efforts to improve water quality, as sustainable agriculture practices can reduce water pollution and promote a healthier environment.
Improving food affordability can create conditions that further soil health by promoting sustainable agriculture practices and reducing soil degradation.
Reducing food waste and improving food distribution can create conditions that further noise reduction by reducing the need for transportation and promoting local food systems.
